content: {"like": ["Hayworth’s performance was praised as the film’s highlight and a key reason for its success.", "The overall musical production was described as gorgeous and worth enjoying.", "Eve Arden’s appearance in the ridiculous hats was noted as fabulous.", "The reviewer encourages viewers to sit back and enjoy the film, calling it one of the few great MGM‑unproduced wartime musical gems."], "dislike": ["The film suffered from technical problems, including difficulties filming Gene Kelly’s solo and issues with the stage size, which the reviewer found unrealistic.", "Costume choices, specifically the ridiculous hats, were criticized, with Hayworth refusing to wear them.", "The inclusion of Gloria DeHaven was questioned, as she had already signed with MGM for larger roles and was not even billed, which the reviewer found odd."]}
